candidate.name: intraday_intrabar_close_location_serial_persistence_238p
candidate.mechanism: population serial persistence of scale-free within-bar close-location states over informative adjacent pairs
candidate.formula: For each positive-range selected bar set x=(log(close)-log(low))/log(high/low). Pool informative adjacent (x_t-1,x_t) pairs separately inside the two halves, require at least 120 and positive variance in both vectors, compute population Pearson rho, and return (1+rho)/2.
candidate.zero_range_rule: A zero-range bar has no state and removes only its directly incident pairs; never bridge across it or impute a state.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_intrabar_close_location_pressure_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both use close position inside the contemporaneous bar range
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: The prior factor aggregates signed boundary distances into a directional mean. Campaign086 discards the marginal direction and measures only temporal correlation of scale-free states; reflection changes the former sign but leaves Campaign086 unchanged.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_bar_direction_continuity_238p
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both can respond to persistent one-sided minute pressure
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Body continuity uses open-to-close signs and exact-zero body support. Campaign086 reads no open, is reflection invariant, and uses relative close location inside high-low intervals with a Pearson state transition.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_adjacent_range_overlap_continuity_238p
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both form adjacent within-half pairs from high-low information
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Range overlap compares two price intervals in log-price space and ignores close. Campaign086 is invariant to interval translation and uses only normalized close states; intervals may have identical overlap but arbitrary Campaign086 persistence.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_microgap_absorption_share_238p
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both ask whether local pressure persists or is absorbed across adjacent bars
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Gap absorption reads current open and whether the prior close lies inside the current range, with a gap-count threshold. Campaign086 reads no open or prior absolute close and correlates contemporaneous within-bar normalized states.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_interbar_gap_body_confirmation_238p
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both are adjacent-bar state persistence ideas
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Gap-body confirmation correlates signed open gaps with signed candle bodies. Campaign086 reads no open, discards signed direction through reflection invariance, and normalizes close by its own high-low interval.
